name: empty_trace
description: An empty trace violates nothing, even policies that would fail at seq 0.
source:
policy starts_with_llm:
  always count(event("llm")) >= 1
policy plan_before_deploy:
  always tool("deploy*") -> previously event("llm", "plan*")
policy confirm_before_delete severity high:
  always tool("delete_*") -> once event("confirmation")
